scope: Every journal venue in data/areas.json, including default-off areas.
source: OpenAlex public Sources API; no API key was used. One bounded batched request returned 43 source records for 42 journal venues.
counts_semantics: OpenAlex source counts_by_year works_count, all work types; 2025 is the latest complete calendar year and 2026 is year to date.

limitations_and_dependencies: The repository has no OPENALEX_API_KEY in .env; this audit used the public keyless Sources API endpoint, which returned the requested metadata.

The collection skill requires article-filtered work samples, affiliation checks, and institution checks. Those checks were not run. Existing LFS pointer files were not treated as work data; git-lfs is unavailable in the environment.

Crossref DOI-level or publisher issue-level reconciliation is still required to establish completeness, including the overlapping 2024 publication year across the two registered Transactions on Networking source records.
